name: Word of Moderate Healing
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 3, inquisitor 2, paladin 3, ranger 3, shaman 2, witch 2

This spell functions like word of light healing except except that it cures 2d4 points of damage plus 1 per two caster level (maximum +5).
